bio: Richard Light is the Carl H. Pforzheimer Jr. Professor of Teaching and Learning at Harvard Graduate School of Education. His Ph.D. is in statistics from Harvard, and after years of teaching statistics he currently focuses on higher education policies and controversies. Light has been asked by four Harvard presidents, Derek Bok, Neil Rudenstine, Larry Summers, and Drew Faust, to explore how to strengthen the undergraduate experience both at Harvard and at a diverse set of other campuses.
